description: This file contains the definition of the PersistentStreamPullingAgent class, which manages pulling, subscription, and delivery mechanisms for persistent streams within Orleans. It handles queue initialization, message reading, subscription management, error handling, and coordination with pub/sub infrastructure.

classes.name: PersistentStreamPullingAgent
classes.description: An internal sealed class that manages pulling data from queue adapters, handling subscriptions, and delivering stream events to consumers in Orleans streams.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the agent, sets up queue cache, receiver, and timer for polling.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the agent, disposing resources and unregistering from pub/sub.

methods.name: AddSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber to a stream.

methods.name: AddSubscriber_Impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for adding a subscriber, establishing handshake and cursor setup.

methods.name: RemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from a stream.

methods.name: RemoveSubscriber_Impl
methods.description: Internal removal process for a subscriber.

methods.name: PumpQueue
methods.description: Main loop to read messages from the queue, handle retries, and process data.

methods.name: ReadFromQueue
methods.description: Reads messages from the queue, manages cache, and registers new streams.

methods.name: RunConsumerCursor
methods.description: Processes and delivers message batches to a consumer, handling errors and delivery retries.

methods.name: DeliverBatchToConsumer
methods.description: Delivers a batch of messages to a stream consumer, returns a handshake token.

methods.name: ErrorProtocol
methods.description: Handles errors during delivery, including faulting subscriptions and notifying streams.

methods.name: RegisterAsStreamProducer
methods.description: Registers the agent as a producer for a specified stream.
